request: Count the words in a text, case-insensitively. A word is a maximal run of letters a-z after lowercasing. Return the `top` most frequent words as (word, count) pairs, sorted by count descending, ties broken alphabetically. `top` is never negative.

signature.python: def word_frequencies(text: str, top: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]
signature.jig: def word_frequencies(text: str, top: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]
